home.title: Hello, {name}
home.intro: Your link, your customers and all your commission, in one place.
home.shareMessage: Get boxes and packaging made with getpack — instant prices through my link

share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — press and hold the link to copy it
share.sheetBody: Anyone who reaches getpack through this link counts as your customer.
share.qrBody: Let the customer scan it with their phone camera to open getpack through your link.
share.qrLabel: QR code of your agent link

notAgent.title: getpack Agent is for sales agents
notAgent.body: This account isn't a getpack sales agent yet. See the programme and apply on getpack.co.
notAgent.appliedBody: The team is reviewing it. Once approved, this app opens for you. See where it stands in your getpack.co account.

ended.title: Your agent agreement has ended
ended.body: You can still read your commission statements and download your withholding tax certificates (50 Tawi) here.

signIn.title: Sign in to getpack Agent
signIn.subtitle: Use your getpack.co account — mobile number, Google, Apple or LINE
signIn.headline:
Sell packaging

with your own link
signIn.lead: Your link and QR, your leads and every baht of commission, in one app on your phone.
signIn.point1: Share your link, or let a customer scan your QR, in one tap
signIn.point2: Register leads so the customer is held for you
signIn.point3: Commission, monthly statements and 50 Tawi, any time

handoff.openingBody: Signing in with your getpack.co account
handoff.failedTitle: This link can't open the app
handoff.failedBody: These links work once and expire quickly. Sign in again to continue.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: getpack Agent always shows current figures, so it needs a connection. Try again once you're back online.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.intro: For now, customers see prices or ask for a quote themselves on getpack.co through your link. The link is remembered for {days} days, so their orders count as yours.

share.title: Send your link
share.body: On LINE, as a copied link, or as a QR code when you meet.

price.title: They see a price at once
price.body: They pick a box, size and quantity and get an instant price; special jobs ask for a quote from the product page.

order.title: They order, you earn
order.body: They order and pay in their own account; the order's commission shows on your Commission page.

quotes.linkBody: Send it before the customer starts looking at prices, so the order counts as yours.
quotes.storefrontBody: Open the products on getpack.co to show a customer how to choose a box and get a price.
quotes.protectBody: Register them as a lead first — they are held for you for {days} days.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what getpack tells you about, and where.
notifications.unreachableTitle: Some channels can't reach you yet

unreachable.line: LINE: no LINE account is linked to this account. Link one in your account on getpack.co.
unreachable.email: E-mail: this account has no e-mail address. Add one in your account on getpack.co.

lead_converted.title: A lead became a customer
lead_converted.body: When someone you registered signs up or orders for the first time

lead_protection_expiring.title: A lead's hold is ending
lead_protection_expiring.body: 7 days and 1 day before a lead is no longer held for you

follow_up_due.title: Time to follow up
follow_up_due.body: At the date and time you set; never at night — it waits until the morning

quote_opened.title: A customer opened your quote
quote_opened.body: The first time a customer opens a quote link you sent

commission_earned.title: Commission earned
commission_earned.body: When an order's commission is ready for the monthly statement

statement_ready.title: Monthly statement ready
statement_ready.body: When Finance approves the month's statement, with the tax withheld

payout_paid.title: Paid
payout_paid.body: When your commission is transferred to your account

payout_profile_needed.title: Payout details needed
payout_profile_needed.body: When commission is waiting but your payout details are incomplete

notifications.locked: Money e-mails are always sent: they are financial records.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.intro: Let getpack Agent show notifications on this phone or computer.
push.iosTitle: On an iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen first
push.iosBody: iPhone and iPad receive notifications when getpack Agent is opened from its Home Screen icon.
push.off: Not on for this device yet
push.denied: This browser has blocked getpack Agent's notifications. Allow them in the browser's site settings.
push.unavailable: This device or browser can't receive getpack Agent notifications. LINE and e-mail still reach you as chosen below.

install.title: Install getpack Agent
install.body: Open it from your Home Screen like an app, full screen, with notifications.
install.bodyIos: Add it to your Home Screen to open it like an app and get notifications on iPhone.

ios.title: Add getpack Agent to your Home Screen
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom bar
ios.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
ios.step3: Tap "Add", then open getpack Agent from its Home Screen icon

profile.title: Profile & agreement
profile.intro: Your agent details, the agreement you accepted, and where you're signed in.
profile.agreementNone: No acceptance is recorded for this account. Contact the team for a copy.
profile.agreementHint: When a new version comes, getpack asks you to read and accept it before it applies.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.intro: Signing getpack Agent out on other devices doesn't affect getpack.co.
sessions.none: No other devices are signed in.
sessions.confirmTitle: Sign getpack Agent out on every other device?
sessions.confirmBody: Other devices will have to sign in again. This device and getpack.co stay signed in.
sessions.done: Signed out {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
